title: Should the dev subcommand and dev flags ship in release builds?
body:
nail/src/args.rs defines developer tooling that ships in every release binary:

- a `dev` subcommand with `play`, `search` and `mx`
- dev flags `--full-dp`, `--bit-p`, `--f32-p` and `--f64-p`, and `--mmseqs-comp-bias-corr`
- a `-hz` case in `handle_clap_error` that prints a different help layout

## Options

- Put them behind a cargo feature named `dev`, so release builds leave them out.
- Remove the ones nobody uses any more.
- Leave them as they are.

I have no lean without knowing which of these Jack still uses.
